generate_rearrangement_episodes: generate rearrangement task episodes by sampling scenes, objects, and receptacles using the RearrangeEpisodeGenerator class
sample_scene_with_generator: sample a new scene and reinitialize the simulator using the generate_scene method of RearrangeEpisodeGenerator
settle_simulation_physics: run physics simulation for a duration to validate object placement stability using the settle_sim method
visualize_scene_receptacles: generate wireframe bounding boxes for each receptacle in the scene using the visualize_scene_receptacles method
extract_sample_region_ratios: extract sample region ratios from a configuration dictionary using the get_sample_region_ratios function
